criteria.criterion: cmd/vloop/run_harness_test.go provides helpers that create a scratch git repository on branch `main` with a git identity set in the repository's own config, initialised with the built binary's `vloop init`, holding a ready loop brief, all committed
criteria.evidence: newRunRepo: git init -b main, local user.name/email, r.vloop("init"), brief written, add -A and commit; TestRunHarness asserts branch, clean status, local identity and brief check

criteria.criterion: The helpers create a fake home whose `.claude.json` marks the scratch repository trusted, and every binary or stub invocation gets HOME, USERPROFILE and XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointing into temporary directories and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM neutralised
criteria.evidence: newRunRepo writes projects[dir and realpath].hasTrustDialogAccepted; r.env uses cleanEnv(r.home) plus GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; all exec goes through r.exec

criteria.criterion: A stub `claude` is put first on PATH: it appends its full argv to a log, answers `--version` and `plugin list --json`, and for the three -p prompts runs a per-test script that can write the plan, files, proposal/verdict, run git, print the result JSON or nothing, and exit with a chosen code
criteria.evidence: runStubSource logs argv, answers --version/plugin, parses the three prompt kinds, sources script.sh (arbitrary shell) with STUB_COST/EXIT/DURATION/TURNS/ERROR/SILENT, prints JSON with modelUsage keyed by --model

criteria.criterion: The stub's script can vary by task and by attempt without editing the harness file
criteria.evidence: PHASE/TASK/ATTEMPT variables with per-PHASE+ARG counters; TestRunHarness uses case "$PHASE:$TASK:$ATTEMPT" and observes both arms

criteria.criterion: The binary is the one TestMain builds once (`binPath`); the harness does not build another
criteria.evidence: r.vloop uses binPath; no go build in the file

criteria.criterion: `TestRunHarness` exists in package main of cmd/vloop and passes: doctor exits 0 with 0 problems, and the stub with `-p "/vloop:work T1" --model sonnet` performs its scripted action, prints JSON whose `modelUsage` is keyed `sonnet`, and is recorded in the argument log
criteria.evidence: Test re-run: ok. Asserts doctor 'doctor: 0 problem(s)', T1.out written, modelUsage has only sonnet, argv log contains the invocation

criteria.criterion: No test reads or writes this repository's `.loop/`, `.claude/`, `.vloop/`, its git history or the real home directory
criteria.evidence: All dirs are t.TempDir(); git always via -C; home is a temp dir and the test asserts it holds only .claude.json

criteria.criterion: Where the stub cannot run on the host OS the harness skips with `t.Skip` naming the reason; it never passes vacuously on darwin or linux
criteria.evidence: newRunRepo t.Skip on windows with reason; on darwin/linux the test runs real assertions
